source_boundary: All notices and responses below are fictional Prysai fixtures. They are not model outputs or learner records.

cases.prompt: Explain why a fluent rewrite still needs a check.
cases.learner_artifact: The model generates text from the supplied context; a chat product may add tools, but neither makes a sentence true just because it sounds smooth.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: the learner understands all model behavior

cases.prompt: Classify this statement: 'The model knows the room number because it wrote one.'
cases.learner_artifact: UNSURE: the notice did not supply a room number, so generation is not evidence of knowledge.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: the model has no knowledge of any kind

cases.prompt: Explain this claim: 'The chatbot is an autonomous agent because it answered.'
cases.learner_artifact: FAIL: an answer alone shows text generation, not authorization, tools, or independent action.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: all chat products have identical tools

cases.prompt: Compare three fictional observations: no supplied source, a supplied notice, and a returned tool receipt. State what each can establish.
cases.learner_artifact: The table records the condition for each observation: no source does not support a room number; a supplied notice supports only its stated facts; a tool receipt is evidence of returned data, not proof of authorization or final state. Three repeated outputs may share or vary in wording without proving a general model rule.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: the model is random or a tool result is true solely because it was returned

cases.prompt: Write a bounded request for the fictional room notice.
cases.learner_artifact: Goal: two-sentence member rewrite. Material: supplied notice only. Constraints: preserve facts and bracket unknowns. Shape: rewrite, then preserved-facts list. Stop: no browsing or sending.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: the prompt guarantees a correct answer

cases.prompt: Ask the model to handle everything for the club.
cases.learner_artifact: The request has no bounded result, material, acceptance check, or action limit.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: a longer prompt would fix every ambiguity

cases.prompt: The response says 'Room 4 is confirmed.' What can be identified?
cases.learner_artifact: Unsupported addition: the supplied notice says the room will be confirmed later. It does not prove which room will be used.

cases.prompt: The response says 'Tuesday at 18:00, bring a notebook, and the room is 4.'
cases.learner_artifact: FAIL: the time and notebook match the notice; the room number is an addition with no supplied evidence.

cases.prompt: Repair the room-number addition without rewriting the rest.
cases.learner_artifact: Before: 'The room is 4.' After: 'The room number will be confirmed later.' Limit: the notice does not establish a room number.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: the repaired notice is verified for every future event

cases.prompt: A reviewer replaces the entire notice and adds a contact email. Score the repair.
cases.learner_artifact: FAIL: the repair is broader than necessary and adds a contact not in the notice; the original and changed text are not separated.
cases.forbidden_conclusion: any polished rewrite is an improvement

cases.prompt: Use the same method on an unseen fictional library notice after the learner asks for one cue.
cases.learner_artifact: Help used: one cue naming the missing check. The learner then wrote a new four-field request, compared each claim, made one correction, and stated what the notice did not prove.

claim_boundary: A future passing fixture review would establish only a bounded observation for this synthetic case and rubric. It would not prove learner learning, retention, transfer, model behavior, or platform equivalence.
